title: FlexLine Draw Fee Tenure Points
content:
| Age of the FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit line on the booking date | Percentage points off the tier's draw fee percent |
|---|---|
| 48 whole calendar months or more | 0.50 |
| 24 to 47 whole calendar months | 0.25 |
| fewer than 24 whole calendar months | none |

For a back-billed draw fee, the tenure points are taken off the tier's draw fee percent by the age of the line from its open date: 48 months or more take off 0.50 percentage points; 24 months or more but fewer than 48 take off 0.25; a younger line takes off nothing; the percent never goes below 0.00. The points come off the percent before the fee is figured on the draw.

Whole calendar months are counted from the open date to the booking date, a month counting only once the booking date's day of the month reaches the open date's day of the month.

*Hypothetical boundary:* a line opened on 12 October is 47 months old on 11 October four years later (0.25 points) and 48 months old on 12 October four years later (0.50 points).
